brief.text: Good morning, Jebin! Mon, Oct 26. No appointments today — enjoy the open day. Use it well: strong body, strong business. Small wins daily, big wins soon.

workout.text: AM upper+abs: floor press 3x10, rows 3x10/arm, shoulder press 3x10, curls 3x10, triceps ext 3x10, dead bugs 3x8/side. PM lower+abs: goblet squats 3x12, deadlifts 3x10, glute bridges 3x15, calf raises 3x15, plank 3x40s, twists 3x12/side.

next.text: Next up: Wed Oct 28, 11am-12pm — winter tire change. Enjoy the open days until then.
